name: local-lead-hunter-skill
title_zh: 专挑没官网的高消费小城商户，导出联系人
tagline_zh: 做网站销售最烦大海捞针。它自动筛出没官网、有预算的小城商户，按消费力排序，直接给你可导出的联系人清单，不群发不骚扰。
tagline_en: Stop cold-calling blind. It ranks website-less businesses in affluent small towns by spending power and exports.
desc_en: Encontra e qualifica negócios locais sem site próprio para venda de sites, escolhendo automaticamente mercados de alto poder aquisitivo, cidades menores e nichos valiosos. Use para pesquisar leads e exportar contatos; não envia mensagens comerciais.
why_zh: 别人按行业捞，它按「没官网 + 小城 + 高消费」三重交集筛，自动跳过已有建站服务的大城市。
why_en: Others filter by industry; it intersects 'no website + small town + high spend' to skip saturated metros and surface the bluest.
limit_zh: 只做线索发现与导出，不代发任何消息；数据来自公开网络，不含未收录商户；需自行确认联系方式有效性，不保证转化率。
limit_en: Lead discovery & export only—no outreach. Uses public web data; unlisted businesses missed. Verify contacts yourself; no conversion guarantee.
title_en: Find high-income small-town businesses without websites
